title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis of chromosomal deletion regions in glioblastoma identifies key genes linked to GABA(A) receptor signaling.
authors: Caglar, Hasan Onur; Meral, Berkay; Caglar, Fulya
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析胶质母细胞瘤缺失区基因，结合分子动力学模拟研究GABA(A)受体相关蛋白结构变化，虽涉及蛋白结构模拟但对象为疾病标志物，方法创新性一般。
abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common aggressive brain tumor in adults. The development of therapy resistance in GBM necessitates the identification of novel biomarkers to guide molecularly targeted treatment strategies. This study aims to identify potential tumor suppressor genes in GBM and to evaluate their potential as therapeutic targets. Genes localized on deletion regions in GBM tumors were selected using the BioMart database. Microarray datasets containing GBM tumor and normal brain tissue samples were analyzed with GEO2R. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed for dDEGs on deletion regions using the String database to identify hub genes. The expression and structural changes of hub genes were examined using GEPIA2 and cBioPortal, respectively. GROMACS software was used to perform molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. A total of 1704 dDEGs located within the deletion regions of GBM tumors were identified. Expression levels of 11 hub genes, including subunits of the entire GABA(A) receptor complex, were significantly downregulated in TCGA GBM samples. Additionally, mutations in CACNA1D, GABRA1, and GABRB2 were predicted to disrupt protein structure and function. Meprobamate was selected as the agonist for GABA(A) receptor-related hub genes. MD simulations indicated that meprobamate remained associated with the GABA(A) receptor but exhibited time-dependent repositioning during the later stages of the simulation. CACNA1D, GABRA1, and GABRB2 may have potential tumor-suppressive roles in GBM. In addition, GABA(A) receptors may represent potential molecular targets in GBM, warranting further experimental investigation.
abstract_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是成人中最常见的侵袭性脑肿瘤。GBM治疗耐药性的发展 necessitates 识别新型生物标志物以指导分子靶向治疗策略。本研究旨在鉴定GBM中潜在的肿瘤抑制基因，并评估其作为治疗靶点的潜力。利用BioMart数据库选择位于GBM肿瘤缺失区域的基因。使用GEO2R分析包含GBM肿瘤和正常脑组织样本的微阵列数据集。利用String数据库为缺失区域上的dDEGs构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络，以识别枢纽基因。分别使用GEPIA2和cBioPortal检查枢纽基因的表达和结构变化。使用GROMACS软件进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟。共鉴定出1704个位于GBM肿瘤缺失区域内的dDEGs。在TCGA GBM样本中，包括整个GABA(A)受体复合物亚基在内的11个枢纽基因的表达水平显著下调。此外，CACNA1D、GABRA1和GABRB2的突变被预测会破坏蛋白质结构和功能。选择甲丙氨酯作为GABA(A)受体相关枢纽基因的激动剂。MD模拟表明，甲丙氨酯与GABA(A)受体保持关联，但在模拟后期表现出时间依赖性重定位。CACNA1D、GABRA1和GABRB2可能在GBM中具有潜在的肿瘤抑制作用。此外，GABA(A)受体可能代表GBM中的潜在分子靶点，值得进一步实验研究。
